# neuromechanics

[Project home](../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Functions that calculate excitation, activation, muscle and tendon forces, paw contact, coupled body motion and output comparisons. Each file represents a named part of the calculation.

`Code/neuromechanics`

| File or folder | Purpose and units |
| --- | --- |
| [__init__.py](__init__.py) | Small functions for excitation, muscles, contact and coupled skeletal dynamics. |
| [activation_derivative.py](activation_derivative.py) | Activation derivative. |
| [activation_dynamics.py](activation_dynamics.py) | Readable equivalent of native MuJoCo activation dynamics (no smoothing). |
| [advance_neuromechanical_timestep.py](advance_neuromechanical_timestep.py) | One complete forward step, with named physical subsystems. |
| [advance_partitioned_timestep.py](advance_partitioned_timestep.py) | Advance legacy timestep. |
| [apply_forward_initial_state.py](apply_forward_initial_state.py) | Apply an explicitly saved state once at t=0, then resume native dynamics. |
| [apply_initial_parameter_file.py](apply_initial_parameter_file.py) | Translate named initial conditions into the native coupled state. |
| [apply_neuromechanical_parameters.py](apply_neuromechanical_parameters.py) | Apply one explicit, versioned physical parameter set before initialization. |
| [apply_wrapping_parameters.py](apply_wrapping_parameters.py) | Install editable muscle wrap geometry before forward integration. |
| [assemble_reference_kinematics.py](assemble_reference_kinematics.py) | Assemble reference kinematics. |
| [attachment_equations.py](attachment_equations.py) | Static MathML for the attachment guide; no runtime mechanics depend on it. |
| [calculate_muscle_route_points.py](calculate_muscle_route_points.py) | Model 3 and forelimb source pulley tangents; no fitted attachments. |
| [clipped_acos.py](clipped_acos.py) | Clipped acos. |
| [compare_simulation_with_experiment.py](compare_simulation_with_experiment.py) | Score all four limbs separately against unchanged source time series. |

| [configured_excitation_samples.py](configured_excitation_samples.py) | All saved input samples, for one fixed normalization scale per muscle. |
| [describe_muscle_paths.py](describe_muscle_paths.py) | Read the real tendon transmission, including branches and wrap objects. |
| [detect_body_fall.py](detect_body_fall.py) | Common collapse/contact criterion for optimization trials and validation. |
| [draw_saved_grf_vectors.py](draw_saved_grf_vectors.py) | Draw the saved four-paw force vectors in the passive MuJoCo viewer. |
